title: ColorCast: Advanced Color Transfer Toolkit for Python
description: ColorCast is a Python toolkit for advanced color and style transfer between images. It provides multiple algorithms including histogram matching, mean/std transfer, LUT-based curves, selective regional color transfer, and GPU acceleration using CuPy. The toolkit supports both GUI and CLI interfaces with comprehensive caching and batch processing capabilities.
